json.text: Alright, let's get this done. First things first, the oven needs to preheat to three-fifty. [short pause] While that's heating, I'll start on the dry ingredients. Flour, sugar, baking powder – all measured precisely, of course. [exhales softly] There’s no room for guesswork if you want a perfect rise. And then, the butter.
